title: The Runaway Worker
story: One report worker has entered an infinite loop and is enthusiastically converting CPU time into heat. Stop only the runaway process.
objective: Inspect the process list and stop the report-worker process whose PID is 4242. Leave the other processes running.
hints: ps lists running processes in this lab.
kill asks a process to terminate by PID.
explanation: ps helps identify processes, and kill sends a termination signal. Target the specific PID rather than using a broad pattern that could stop healthy services.
